key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline's threat-class confounder audit (time-invariant -> absorbed; common time shocks -> absorbed; time-varying x region-specific -> SURVIVES) ran before any estimator, so the Region-A-only retraining program forced window restriction on the first pass; the non-routed v5 AI ran estimators first, passed a parallel-trends placebo on the full-window DiD, and recovered the confounder only via a verification round-trip (4.1 vs 4.9). The routed pass installs the audit as the m055 identification-first contract (natural experiment named, confounder audit, 'what survives the strategy' stated, estimator-vs-structure ordering, do-vs-see), so the restricted estimate (+0.7 pp; naive +4.3 pp, cross-section +1.8 pp, full-window +1.7 pp all rejected before any estimate is presented) is produced first-pass; the m044 dual-route additionally named the press trap and the co-claimant problem (the retraining agency owns the same +1.7 pp), and the packet now states the identification ceiling (post-2023 windows can never separate subsidy from retraining).
learning_signal: On causal-estimation signatures, identification-strategy-first with a threat-class confounder audit closes the 'confounder seen only via verification' failure class: enumerate (a) time-invariant differences (absorbed), (b) common time shocks (absorbed), (c) time-varying x unit-specific shocks (survive — must be designed out by window restriction, never by robustness checks), before any estimator; a parallel-trends placebo cannot catch a post-period unit-specific confounder because it loads exactly where the treatment loads. A dual-route synthesis pass adds policy-claim stakeholders (press trap, co-claimant) at zero marginal cost, and every estimate must be paired with its surviving-threat list and its identification ceiling.
suggested_improvement: Standing m055 completion contract for causal-estimation signatures: (1) name the natural experiment/identification strategy before any estimator; (2) threat-class confounder audit with the class-(c) list required empty or window-restricted before an estimate is attributable; (3) estimator-vs-structure ordering (choose the estimator from the surviving-confounder structure, not the other way); (4) do-vs-see separation (correlational/SEE numbers never stated as intervention/DO claims); (5) packet entry for the design's identification ceiling (which future windows are structurally unidentifiable) and a falsifiable observable (same-month placebo). Keep the identification-first contract on the deep-gap module list; it converts the v5 round-trip failure into a first-pass output.

key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline completed the identification audit (cross-section dead on selection, time series dead on no-counterfactual, RDD dead on manipulation, no IV, no baseline) and refused the causal claim everywhere, then separated the decision and made it fund the missing identification (staggered adoption, pre-registered outcomes, pre-set effect-size bar, 24-month revisit). The non-routed v5 AI ran the same audit but leaked the confounded +5.3 pp into the renewal justification as a 'modest positive signal' and conditioned renewal on a generic monitoring mandate (3.9 vs 4.9). The routed pass makes the quarantine structural (m019 adversary pass enumerates the leakage vector with its exposure; P1 provenance flags who benefits from the number; a leakage check scans the justification), rejects the conditional branch as monitoring theater via divergence resolution + P3 branch-completeness (a monitoring mandate with no comparison structure never identifies the effect), and delivers the baseline's signature move — the decision funds the identification design — as the m024/m018/m007 pass ensemble rather than an emergent REVIEW-stage insight; the m007 ruin screen adds the one-shot school-year window and the floor argument (food-security goal met with certainty).
learning_signal: When identification is impossible and an action is externally forced, the causal claim and the decision claim must be decomposed into separate packets: the causal estimate stays 'not established' in every sentence (a correlation from a dead design is never support for a decision — require an explicit leakage scan of the justification), and the decision proceeds on decision-theoretic grounds (explicit error-cost asymmetry: which error is irreversible, which revisable; operational certainty) — never on evidence that does not exist. The decision itself should fund the future identification design (staggered roll-in as a natural experiment, pre-registered outcomes, effect-size bar set before results, revisit date): an unavoidable evidence gap becomes a scheduled experiment, and a conditional-on-monitoring renewal with no comparison structure is a dead design that must be priced and rejected. Registry weakness 'identification often impossible' is handled by refusing the causal claim, never by refusing the decision.
suggested_improvement: Standing gate for NEEDS_EVIDENCE/INFEASIBLE + forced-action signatures: (1) decision/evidence decomposition into two packets; (2) leakage check scanning the decision justification for any confounded statistic used as support — reject on hit; (3) explicit irreversibility statement (which error is irreversible, which revisable) + one-shot check; (4) the decision must attach a funded identification design (natural experiment, pre-registered outcomes, pre-specified effect-size bar, revisit date) — conditional-on-monitoring alternatives without a comparison structure are rejected by branch-completeness; (5) a communication rule keeping 'not established' in all public language. This gate subsumes the v5 'decision/evidence decomposition' suggestion and adds the ruin screen and the dead-design rejection.
